lines.zh: 我在村边那条浅河里，慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: I drift through the shallow river by the village, tail slow.

lines.zh: 泥底下有吃的，我一路拱过去。
lines.en: Food lies in the silt; I root my way along.

lines.zh: 我们三条并排游，谁也不抢前。
lines.en: The three of us swim abreast, none pushing ahead.

lines.zh: 我逆着水流走，鳍一张一合。
lines.en: I work against the current, fins opening and closing.

lines.zh: 水渠里的水只到我的背。
lines.en: The ditch water barely covers my back.

lines.zh: 我穿过桥洞，闻见石头的凉味。
lines.en: I pass under the bridge and smell cold stone.

lines.zh: 冬天我沉在冰下，慢得几乎不动。
lines.en: In winter I sink beneath ice and barely move.

lines.zh: 我拐进稻田，水暖得像洗澡。
lines.en: I turn into the rice paddy; the water is warm as a bath.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边的草根找虫。
lines.en: I comb the bank's grass roots for insects.

lines.zh: 水面落下叶子，我从下面顶它。
lines.en: A leaf lands on the water; I bump it from below.

lines.zh: 我游过一整片睡莲，被挡了三次。
lines.en: I cross a lily bed and get blocked three times.

lines.zh: 池塘的水浑，我照样认得路。
lines.en: The pond is murky, and still I know the way.

lines.zh: 我每天绕这口塘一圈，习惯了。
lines.en: I circle this pond daily; it has become habit.

lines.zh: 泥里冒出气泡，我从上面划过去。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud and I skim over them.

lines.zh: 我从荷叶下面穿过去，没碰着。
lines.en: I pass under the lily pads without touching one.

lines.zh: 钓钩在水里晃，我绕开了。
lines.en: A hook sways in the water. I go around it.

lines.zh: 雨点砸在水面，我沉深一点。
lines.en: Rain hits the surface, so I sink a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥底找落下的种子。
lines.en: I comb the mud bottom for fallen seeds.

lines.zh: 我停在荷叶下，什么都不想。
lines.en: I rest beneath a lily pad, thinking of nothing.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一张一合，只是呼吸。
lines.en: My mouth opens and closes, only breathing.

lines.zh: 水底这块石头我看了整年。
lines.en: I have looked at this bottom stone for a whole year.

lines.zh: 我偶尔翻个身，露出白肚皮。
lines.en: Now and then I roll and show my pale belly.

lines.zh: 这池塘太安静，连青蛙都睡了。
lines.en: The pond is so quiet even the frogs are asleep.

lines.zh: 我把鳍撑在泥上，省点力气。
lines.en: I prop my fins on the mud to save some strength.

lines.zh: 有点痒，我在石头上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: Something itches; I rub against a stone.

lines.zh: 水面的光晃来晃去，我看困了。
lines.en: Light wobbles on the surface and makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我的鳞不算好看，但很结实。
lines.en: My scales are not pretty, but they hold.

lines.zh: 我在等一场雨，把水搅开。
lines.en: I wait for a rain to stir this water up.

lines.zh: 一条蚯蚓落水，我听见了响。
lines.en: A worm drops in and I hear the small splash.

lines.zh: 这片水草太高，挡住我的路。
lines.en: These weeds have grown too tall and block my way.

lines.zh: 我悬在中间那层水里，什么都不做。
lines.en: I hang in the middle depth, doing nothing at all.

lines.zh: 偶尔有鸭子划过来，我就让开。
lines.en: When a duck paddles over, I simply move aside.

lines.zh: 你蹲在塘边洗手，我凑过去瞧。
lines.en: You crouch at the pond to wash, so I drift up to look.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我不躲。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I do not flee.

lines.zh: 我认得你的桶，还有里面的水。
lines.en: I know your bucket, and the water inside it.

lines.zh: 你在洗东西，我把碎屑吃了。
lines.en: You are washing something; I eat the scraps.

lines.zh: 我看了你一会儿，又低头拱泥。
lines.en: I watch you a moment, then go back to rooting.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水里，我绕着它转。
lines.en: Your feet are in the water and I circle them.

lines.zh: 我没什么可怕你的，你也不饿。
lines.en: I see no reason to fear you; you are not hungry.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我慢慢退开。
lines.en: You reach toward me and I ease away slowly.

lines.zh: 我浮到你面前，嘴露出水面。
lines.en: I rise before you with my mouth above water.

lines.zh: 你的影子一晃，水面就碎了。
lines.en: Your shadow shifts and the surface breaks apart.

lines.zh: 我被砍中背部，鳞片散在水里。
lines.en: The blade hits my back and scales scatter in the water.

lines.zh: 我疼得往泥里钻，只露出尾巴。
lines.en: Pain drives me into the silt with only my tail out.

lines.zh: 这一刀不深，但我记住了。
lines.en: The cut is not deep, but I remember it.

lines.zh: 血混进浑水，几乎看不出来。
lines.en: Blood mixes into the murk and hardly shows.

lines.zh: 我在水里打了两个滚才稳住。
lines.en: I tumble twice in the water before steadying myself.

lines.zh: 你打在我侧腹，我甩尾就跑。
lines.en: You strike my flank and I bolt with a tail flick.

lines.zh: 我躲到石头下，等你走。
lines.en: I hide under a stone and wait for you to go.

lines.zh: 我这点肉，不值得你动刀。
lines.en: My small flesh is not worth your blade.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里发凉，反而舒服。
lines.en: The wound feels cool in the water, almost pleasant.

lines.zh: 我游歪了半圈，才找回方向。
lines.en: I swim half a circle crooked before finding my way.

lines.zh: 你丢下的面包屑，我一粒粒捡。
lines.en: You toss bread crumbs and I pick up every one.

lines.zh: 我闻见面团的味道，游得直了。
lines.en: I smell dough and swim in a straight line.

lines.zh: 你手里的玉米，比水草香多了。
lines.en: The corn in your hand smells far better than weeds.

lines.zh: 我抢在你撒手之前就张了嘴。
lines.en: I open my mouth before you even let go.

lines.zh: 同伴也来了，我们挤成一团。
lines.en: My companions arrive and we crowd into a knot.

lines.zh: 那点吃的在泥上，我一口吸进去。
lines.en: The morsel sits in the silt; I suck it in.

lines.zh: 我知道有钩，可这味道太熟。
lines.en: I know about the hook, but this smell is familiar.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃袋子，我整条鱼都精神了。
lines.en: You rustle the bag and every fin of mine wakes.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的手，从塘这头到那头。
lines.en: I follow your hand from one end of the pond.

lines.zh: 吃完了我还张着嘴，等下一口。
lines.en: When it is gone I keep my mouth open for more.

lines.zh: 你踩进塘里，把我撞得打转。
lines.en: You step into the pond and spin me around.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的小腿，滑了一下。
lines.en: I bump your calf and slide off it.

lines.zh: 三条鱼挤在浅水里，全撞乱了。
lines.en: Three fish crowd the shallows and collide in a mess.

lines.zh: 你踢开石头，我差点被压住。
lines.en: You kick a stone loose and it nearly pins me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞蹭掉了一小片，不碍事。
lines.en: A scale scrapes off; it is no great matter.

lines.zh: 水被搅得看不见底，我往上浮。
lines.en: The water clouds to the bottom, so I rise.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我才敢贴回岸边。
lines.en: You step back, and only then do I return.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我甩了一身水。
lines.en: That knock makes me shake water everywhere.

lines.zh: 我撞在桶壁上，桶里的水晃了。
lines.en: I hit the bucket wall and the water sloshes.

lines.zh: 我把自己卡进石缝，动不了了。
lines.en: I wedge myself in a rock gap and cannot move.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我追着另一条鲤鱼。
lines.en: When spring warms the water, I chase another carp.

lines.zh: 我们隔着水草互相撞了两下。
lines.en: We butt each other twice through the weeds.

lines.zh: 她绕着塘游，我一直在后面。
lines.en: She circles the pond and I stay right behind.

lines.zh: 我们甩尾搅起泥，那就是信号。
lines.en: We thrash the silt up; that is the signal.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩上等她过来。
lines.en: I wait on the shallows for her to come.

lines.zh: 我们靠得很近，鳍碰着鳍。
lines.en: We come close enough that our fins touch.

lines.zh: 卵粘在水草上，我守着那片。
lines.en: Eggs cling to the weeds and I guard that patch.

lines.zh: 她的鳞比我亮，我绕着看。
lines.en: Her scales shine brighter than mine; I circle to look.

lines.zh: 明年这时，塘里会多很多小鱼。
lines.en: By this time next year the pond will hold many fry.

lines.zh: 她走了，我慢慢游回泥底。
lines.en: She leaves; I drift back down to the mud.

lines.zh: 我含起一颗螺，嚼不碎就吐了。
lines.en: I mouth a snail, cannot crush it, and spit it out.

lines.zh: 有根羽毛沉下来，我顶着玩。
lines.en: A feather sinks down and I push it around.

lines.zh: 我捡了块亮石头，含了一路。
lines.en: I pick up a bright stone and carry it a while.

lines.zh: 我把面包屑从石缝里吸出来。
lines.en: I suck bread crumbs out of a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 你掉的线头被我咬住了。
lines.en: I catch the thread you dropped and hold it.

lines.zh: 我试着吞那枚果核，太大。
lines.en: I try to swallow a fruit pit; it is too big.

lines.zh: 我把漂来的花瓣顶到岸边。
lines.en: I nudge a floating petal over to the bank.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西，我就忘了游。
lines.en: With something in my mouth I forget to swim.

lines.zh: 我含着石子敲底，听个响。
lines.en: I hold a pebble and tap the bottom to hear it.

lines.zh: 那东西不是吃的，我又吐了。
lines.en: That thing is not food, so I spit it out again.

lines.zh: 水里有虫在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something wriggles in the water and I see it.

lines.zh: 一只落水的甲虫在水面打转。
lines.en: A beetle that fell in is spinning on the surface.

lines.zh: 我盯住那片晃动的草根。
lines.en: I fix on that patch of trembling grass roots.

lines.zh: 有东西在泥里拱，肯定能吃。
lines.en: Something roots in the silt; it must be edible.

lines.zh: 我转过去，尾巴先摆了一下。
lines.en: I turn toward it, tail flicking first.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼比我慢，我注意到了。
lines.en: That little fish is slower than me; I notice.

lines.zh: 水面上的蚊子，落得太低了。
lines.en: A mosquito lands on the water, far too low.

lines.zh: 我把头对准了那点波纹。
lines.en: I aim my head at that small ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 有吃的在前面，我不想等了。
lines.en: Food is ahead and I do not want to wait.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，它跑了。
lines.en: I stare too long and it gets away.

lines.zh: 我跟着那只虫，不快也不慢。
lines.en: I trail the insect, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 它往草里躲，我从下面绕。
lines.en: It hides in the weeds; I go around underneath.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴靠近，一点一点。
lines.en: I approach with my mouth open, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，看得见它。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides and keep it in view.

lines.zh: 它一停，我的鳍就僵在半空。
lines.en: The moment it stops, my fins freeze half-raised.

lines.zh: 我算好距离，再往前挤半尺。
lines.en: I judge the distance and push forward half a foot.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的鳍就跟着转。
lines.en: When it moves, my fins turn with it.

lines.zh: 我绕到它下面，等它下沉。
lines.en: I slip beneath it and wait for it to sink.

lines.zh: 水草挡了一下，我绕开。
lines.en: A weed stem blocks me and I go around.

lines.zh: 近了，我连呼吸都放轻。
lines.en: I am near now and even my breathing goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我一口吸进去，连泥一起。
lines.en: I suck it in, mud and all.

lines.zh: 我咬住虫子的尾巴，它还在挣。
lines.en: I clamp the insect's tail; it is still struggling.

lines.zh: 我用头一顶，把它撞进嘴里。
lines.en: I butt it once and knock it into my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一口没什么力气，但够用。
lines.en: This bite has little force, but it will do.

lines.zh: 泥和虫一起进了肚子。
lines.en: Mud and insect both go down into my belly.

lines.zh: 它卡在我嘴里，我甩了甩头。
lines.en: It sticks in my mouth and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我咬碎甲壳，声音很脆。
lines.en: I crunch the shell and it makes a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 抢食的时候，我也会咬同伴。
lines.en: When food is scarce I bite my companions too.

lines.zh: 我把猎物压在水草上。
lines.en: I press the catch down against the weeds.

lines.zh: 吃完了，嘴上还挂着泥。
lines.en: When I finish, mud still hangs from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我在村口的池塘里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the pond at the village gate.

lines.zh: 水很浅，我的背快露出来了。
lines.en: The water is shallow and my back nearly shows.

lines.zh: 我和另外两条一起被放进水里。
lines.en: I am put into the water with two others.

lines.zh: 这条河我熟，从上游到下游。
lines.en: I know this river, from the headwaters down.

lines.zh: 稻田刚灌满水，我游了进来。
lines.en: The paddy just filled up and I swam in.

lines.zh: 我落进水里，溅了一小圈。
lines.en: I drop into the water with a small splash.

lines.zh: 冰刚化，我就浮上来了。
lines.en: The ice has just melted and I float up.

lines.zh: 这里的水草够多，我留下了。
lines.en: There are enough weeds here, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我从瀑布下的深潭钻出来。
lines.en: I surface from the deep pool below the falls.

lines.zh: 这个池塘里已经有十几条同类。
lines.en: This pond already holds a dozen of my kind.

lines.zh: 水面被火把照红，我往下沉。
lines.en: A torch reddens the surface and I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我被捞起来又掉了，摔在草上。
lines.en: I am lifted, dropped, and land on the grass.

lines.zh: 我在水里居然也会闷，真怪。
lines.en: Even in water I can suffocate; that is strange.

lines.zh: 塘水被炸得退开，我搁在泥上。
lines.en: The blast pushes the pond away and leaves me on mud.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过水面，我的鳍破了。
lines.en: An arrow skims the water and tears my fin.

lines.zh: 有光打进水里，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Light pierces the water and my whole body tingles.

lines.zh: 塘里没食了，我嚼水草度日。
lines.en: The pond has no food left; I chew weeds to get by.

lines.zh: 雷打进池塘，我翻了个白肚。
lines.en: Lightning hits the pond and I flip belly up.

lines.zh: 水一下没了，我掉进黑里。
lines.en: The water vanishes and I fall into blackness.
